I added item removal, discount codes, and a total in cents to `Shop.Cart`. All 20 tests pass (18 unit tests and 2 doctests), and `mix credo --strict` reports no issues.

- **`remove_item/3`**: removes units from an item. Removing as many or more units than the cart holds deletes the item. Removing a SKU that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
- **`apply_code/2`**: takes the customer's string. "SAVE10" gives 10% off the item subtotal, and "FREESHIP" waives shipping. Unknown codes return
